title: ErrorCode
description:
Why a verifier rejected something. One list, two renderings: an RFC 9457 Problem Details response carries it in a `code` extension member on the HTTP side, and a Receipt carries it in `error` on the evidence side. It is canonical model rather than a transport detail precisely so those two cannot drift — see docs/architecture/adr/0001-transport-and-errors.md.

The list describes the domain, not what is built today. A rejection reason exists because a protocol rule exists, so the codes track the documented rules in docs/protocols/ rather than the Go error values that happen to implement some of them. Codes for rules not yet implemented cost nothing; a missing code costs a schema change and a regeneration at the moment somebody is trying to reject a request.

Request handling — the caller got the call itself wrong:
  request_malformed          the body is not the shape this endpoint accepts
  idempotency_key_missing    a state-changing call arrived without one
  idempotency_conflict       the key was reused for a materially different request

Securing format — the mandate did not survive its own envelope:
  mandate_malformed          not parseable as the securing format requires
  signature_invalid          the signature did not verify
  algorithm_unsupported      the algorithm was absent, was 'none', or was not the resolved key's
  mandate_expired            exp has passed
  mandate_not_yet_valid      nbf has not arrived
  disclosure_unmatched       a disclosure the issuer never committed to
  disclosure_insufficient    a claim this verifier needs was withheld
  key_binding_required       policy requires proof of possession and none arrived
  key_binding_invalid        proof of possession arrived and did not hold

Key resolution — the signer could not be established:
  key_unknown                the key reference resolves to nothing
  key_expired                the key is past the life it was published with

Authorisation — the mandate parsed and was signed, and still may not proceed:
  mandate_version_unsupported  the credential type carries a version this verifier does not implement
  checkout_hash_mismatch       the recomputed hash of the checkout does not match the claim
  payment_binding_mismatch     the Payment Mandate is bound to a different checkout
  constraint_violated          the closed mandate falls outside the open mandate's constraints
  constraint_type_unknown      a constraint type this verifier cannot evaluate; rejected, never ignored
  agent_key_mismatch           the closed mandate was signed by a key the open mandate does not endorse
  open_mandate_required        an agent-signed closed mandate arrived with nothing to check it against
  open_mandate_outstanding     a further open mandate before the rejection receipt for the previous one

Instrument — the credential does not fit the purchase:
  credential_scope_mismatch  the payment credential is not scoped to this checkout

Identity — the caller could not be established as a known agent:
  agent_unknown              the key reference is one the registry has never held
  agent_unverified           the agent is known and the request signature does not check out
  signature_replayed         the signature has already been used inside its window
  signature_scope_mismatch   the signature is not bound to this domain or this operation

Service — the failure is not the caller's:
  verifier_unavailable       the verifier could not reach a conclusion for its own reasons
